title: Make authenticated DIO vector wire bytes independent of production codecs
description: P2 test-oracle integrity: generate_authenticated_schc_dio.py builds canonical wire_hex/dio_hex/ipv6_hex/link_payload_hex with production LichenFrame, IPv6Header, Icmpv6Message, and encode_rule255. The expected verdicts and Schnorr signature are independent, but the exact protocol bytes are not: a shared production encoding bug can regenerate a new canonical vector that Python accepts and all other implementations are forced to copy. Replace packet/frame/SCHC construction with a small literal spec encoder (including checksum and all DIO base Flags/Reserved octets), pin fixed KAT bytes, and keep production decoders only in consumer tests.
